parts.text: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target: the same chosen felt Moss character in reference. Preserve exact green wool texture, cream face/belly, curled sage sprout, amber charm, round ears, dark glossy eyes, face proportions, body scale and canvas position. Change ONLY the arm pose: both paws hold a small traditional wood-handled rubber stamp, with a short amber rounded handle and dark-green round base, in front of its lower belly. It looks down at the stamp with a pleased focused closed-mouth smile, ready to press it downward. Stamp is about one quarter body width; clearly readable silhouette. No ink mark, writing, notebook or other objects. Full body including feet/sprout, generous margins, same square canvas and character scale. Background perfectly flat pure magenta #FF00FF, no shadow/floor/gradient. No extra limbs or scenery. No text or logos.
